column1: # Expectations for the module 09 commands (the layer 1 rubric in machine form).
# eval.sh checks every command against its row. A new command with no row is a
# FAIL, "no expectations" - intent has to be declared deliberately.
#   name       command name (= file name without .md)
#   needs_arg  y/n - the command takes an argument ($ARGUMENTS/$1): it needs an
#              argument-hint plus a fallback branch ("if not given, ask")
#   analyzer   y/n - the command only reads or analyzes: it needs a guard
#              ("do not write code" / "do not commit" / "do not change" / "do not start")
#   ai_role    expected binding to .ai/: the role file name, referenced
#              conditionally in the body; MULTI (multi-role, points at the
